title: Quake plus Descent
author: DarkDigital
selftext:
Another Sunday project. Since my AI already did the Doom plus Descent one to make Doomscent. It was easy for it to reuse everything to make Quakescent. Seemed natural.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=51zv19tK1pI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=51zv19tK1pI)

So you can fly around as the Descent ship, 1 or 2 version, and all the weapons and everything are their equivalents or scaled appropriately. And there's options to choose Quake-like or Descent-like movement if you want. The cheats from both games work in combination together. etc. Multiplayer works even.

Requires you to have your own files from both games of course. But shareware can work.

More information, etc. here: [https://github.com/wootbeer/Quakescent/](https://github.com/wootbeer/Quakescent/)
